whitelist.meaning: Uniswap Universal Router: run a batch of swap and transfer commands in one call. The commands and inputs are shown as raw bytes, not decoded.
Uniswap Universal Router: run a batch of swap and transfer commands in one call. The commands and inputs are shown as raw bytes, not decoded.
Uniswap SwapRouter02: swap an exact amount of one token for as much as possible of another, through one pool. The minimum received is shown.
Uniswap SwapRouter02: swap an exact amount of one token for as much as possible of another, along a Uniswap v3 path of one or more pools. The minimum received is shown.
Uniswap SwapRouter02: swap as little as possible of one token for an exact amount of another, through one Uniswap v3 pool. The maximum spent is shown.
Uniswap SwapRouter02: buy an exact amount of a token along a Uniswap v3 path of one or more pools, spending at most the maximum shown.
Uniswap SwapRouter02: run several of these calls in one transaction, in order. A call that fails fails the whole batch.
Uniswap SwapRouter02: run several of these calls in one transaction, in order, before a deadline. A call that fails fails the whole batch.
Uniswap SwapRouter02: unwrap all the WETH the router holds into the native coin, if at least a minimum, and send it to an address.
Uniswap SwapRouter02: send all the native coin the router holds to you.

Aave V3 WETH gateway: repay your variable-rate debt in the native coin the call sends. Any excess is refunded.

Compound V3: withdraw an asset from your account in the market and send it to an address.
Compound V3: supply an asset to a market for another account, which the market then credits to that account. The account is shown when it is not you.
Compound V3: withdraw an asset from one account to another, by an account the source lets act for it. Shown with both accounts when either is not you.
Compound V3: withdraw an asset from your account in the market and send it to an address.
Compound V3 bulker: run a batch of supply, withdraw, transfer and reward actions on your account, in order.
Lido withdrawal queue: request to turn stETH into ETH. Each amount becomes a request owned by the given address.
Lido withdrawal queue: claim the ETH of finished withdrawal requests you own, sent to you.
